## Changes since alpha-first-20260911

- 6170341 Merge physical refinement and reduced-provider increments with hosted quality evidence
- 5654619 feat: measure complete physical refinements from exact-v2 states
- 151b798 feat: add bounded reduced-coordinate sampled force provider
- 82c0796 ci: retain source-bound raw quality reports and record family verification
- 60c9cc1 feat: add independently checked reduced-coordinate force evaluator
- b42c0ca feat: compare six independent exact-v2 refinement trajectories
- 6fad3ca docs: record first public alpha and verify downloaded release

This is an alpha prerelease of a diagnostic-only, unqualified scientific runtime. It does not establish PDE qualification or reproduce the original research target.
Status and active plan: https://github.com/nivatechnologies/nsbu-solver/blob/6170341c42a64348c7d99bdfd4fc3653454f22a8/project-status.json and https://github.com/nivatechnologies/nsbu-solver/blob/6170341c42a64348c7d99bdfd4fc3653454f22a8/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
Validation evidence: https://github.com/nivatechnologies/nsbu-solver/blob/6170341c42a64348c7d99bdfd4fc3653454f22a8/evidence/runtime-alpha/summary.json
